assets.name: prop-spokeshave-iron-blank-sv2
assets.desc: Flat 2.5 mm steel spokeshave iron blank, T-shaped top view: 54 mm wide x 30 mm cutting body with a centred 34 mm wide x 12 mm upper shoulder/tang; 8-point outline extruded flat.

assets.name: prop-spokeshave-sole-blank-sv2
assets.desc: Handle-less beech spokeshave sole/body blank: 110 mm long bar, 32 mm deep, 20 mm tall with chamfered upper edges along its length, plus a raised 60x12x6 mm throat/bed ridge on top centre (total height 26 mm).

assets.name: prop-spokeshave-wedge-sv2
assets.desc: Small walnut locking wedge blank: 32 mm wide, 40 mm long, tapering from 10 mm thick at one end to 3 mm at the other (single sloped top face).

assets.name: prop-spokeshave-handle-blank-sv2
assets.desc: Single beech spokeshave wing handle blank: upright octagonal shaft 85 mm long, ~14 mm across at base tapering to 70% at the top, flat ends.
